abrupt_lane_change.reason: B0 found lane/map geometry but no frozen actor-to-lane membership and no frozen lane-change event label/threshold. Inventing nearest-lane association now would create a new unsupported semantic.

actor_near_beam_boundary.frozen_definition: absolute circular/angular distance from current causal receiver azimuth to nearest internal 32-beam decision boundary <= beam_boundary_tolerance_deg

braking.frozen_definition: two most recent valid causal velocity states exist and current speed is strictly lower than immediately previous valid speed

cyclist_lateral_maneuver.frozen_definition: current causal speed >= frozen 0.25 m/s and abs(lateral_velocity_H0) > abs(longitudinal_velocity_H0)

dynamic_blocker_between_transmitter_and_.reason: dynamic LoS/blockage was optional upstream; B0 did not establish a frozen executable dynamic-blocker intersection authority. No new blockage model will be invented.

intersection_turn.reason: B0 confirms lane/crosswalk/map features but no frozen intersection polygon or actor-intersection-turn label. A new map-matching/turn-threshold pipeline would be an unsupported new scientific definition at this boundary.

long_range_small_angular_separation.reason: beam geometry is frozen but B0 found no frozen 'long range' threshold. Creating one after formal population unseal would weaken the preregistered failure analysis.

partial_occlusion.reason: B0 found causal LiDAR point support but no frozen explicit partial-occlusion annotation/estimator. Point-count reduction alone is not sufficient to claim occlusion.

pedestrian_crossing.frozen_definition: current causal speed >= frozen 0.25 m/s and abs(lateral_velocity_H0) > abs(longitudinal_velocity_H0)

receiver_near_FoV_edge.frozen_definition: receiver azimuth is inside [-12,+12] deg and distance to nearest support edge is <= one frozen primary-32 decision-cell width

short_range_high_angular_velocity.reason: causal range/angular motion are available, but B0 found no frozen semantic threshold for what constitutes 'short range'. No formal-dependent threshold will be created.

temporary_missing_track.frozen_definition: current anchor state is valid and causal history contains at least one invalid-state run strictly before anchor with at least one valid state before and at least one valid state after that invalid run

two_actors_same_or_neighboring_beam.frozen_definition: at least two distinct current causal non-ego actors inside communication azimuth support map to primary-32 decision beam indices whose absolute index difference is <= 1
